consequence.statement: An internal vendored ACME client package gains support for the ACME profiles extension. The release notes list it under Other (Cleanup or Flake) and state no operator-facing effect.

assertion.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 patches its internal third_party/forked/acme package to support the ACME profiles extension; this is listed as a cleanup item with no stated effect on operators.

checks.detail: the subject and change are not both confirmed by an artifact validator
